claims.statement: The guide is the Global curriculum guide for community health workers, published by WHO in 2025.

claims.statement: The guide adopts the principles and structure of competency-based education.
claims.quote: This CHW curriculum guide adopts the principles and structure of competency-based education (CBE).

claims.statement: CBE is oriented to outcome abilities with less emphasis on time-based training.

claims.statement: The tutor's role becomes that of a facilitator.

claims.statement: Learning activities include individual, small-group and shadowing experiences.

claims.statement: The content is organised into six competency domains, 12 universal modules (11 practice-activity plus one basic science), and four role-specific modules with 28 topics.
claims.quote: The content is organized into six competency domains, 12 universal modules (11 practice activities plus one module of basic science knowledge), and four role-specific modules, comprising 28 role-specific topics organized under the four modules.
claims.locator: 3.1 Overview of the CHW curriculum guide

claims.statement: There are 25 competencies relevant to all CHWs.
claims.quote: There are 25 competencies that are relevant to all CHWs across all contexts, including the breadth of the practice activities in the universal and role-specific modules.

claims.statement: Universal modules form the basis of any curriculum developed or adapted from the guide.
